verses.text: In the eighth month of the second year that Darius was king, the LORD gave this message to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo:
"The LORD was very angry with your ancestors.
So tell the people, 'This is what the LORD of Armies says: Return to me,' says the LORD of Armies, 'and I will return to you,' says the LORD of Armies.

Do not be like your ancestors. The earlier prophets told them, 'This is what the LORD of Armies says: Turn from your evil ways and your evil practices.' But they would not listen or pay attention to me, says the LORD.
Where are your ancestors now? And the prophets, do they live forever?

But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets to announce, caught up with your ancestors, didn't they? "Then they turned back and said, 'The LORD of Armies has done to us what our ways and our practices deserved, just as he decided to do.'"
On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the LORD gave this message to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo:
During the night I had a vision. I saw a man riding a red horse. He was standing among the myrtle trees in a ravine. Behind him were red, brown, and white horses.
I asked, "What are these, my lord?" The angel who was talking with me answered, "I will show you what they are."
Then the man standing among the myrtle trees explained, "They are the ones the LORD has sent to go throughout the earth."
They reported to the angel of the LORD who was standing among the myrtle trees, "We have gone throughout the earth, and we found the whole world at rest and in peace."
Then the angel of the LORD said, "LORD of Armies, how long will you keep holding back mercy from Jerusalem and the towns of Judah? You have been angry with them for these seventy years."
So the LORD spoke kind and comforting words to the angel who talked with me.
Then the angel who was talking with me said, "Announce this: 'This is what the LORD of Armies says: I am very jealous for Jerusalem and Zion.
But I am very angry with the nations that feel so secure. I was only a little angry with my people, but the nations made their suffering much worse.'
"So this is what the LORD says: 'I will return to Jerusalem with mercy, and my house will be rebuilt there,' says the LORD of Armies. 'A measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem.'
"Announce this also: 'This is what the LORD of Armies says: My towns will again overflow with good things. The LORD will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.'"
Then I looked up, and I saw four horns.
I asked the angel who was talking with me, "What are these?" He answered me, "These are the horns that scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem."
Then the LORD showed me four craftsmen.

I asked, "What are these coming to do?" He answered, "These horns scattered Judah so badly that no one could raise their head. But the craftsmen have come to terrify those nations and throw down the horns of the nations that raised their horns against the land of Judah to scatter its people."
